faces.unit: switches per defender-minute (sim clock; 1 defender-minute = 60 sim-s a body spent out of possession)
faces.what: 换人盯 as it happens today: a marker's assigned man CHANGES
faces.denNote: denominator = defender body-ticks × DT / 60; MOVING with sent-offs and with possession share — disclosed per face

faces.unit: switches per defender-match (the 240 s match clock — the dual axis)
faces.what: the same count on the match clock (clock honesty)
a marker LOSES his man with no replacement assignment
a body is GIVEN a mark (the churn cycle's other half)
a body is licensed to hunt the ball
a licensed presser is DE-licensed mid-flight (the 疯狂抽动 shape)
how much of his defending life a body actually HAS a mark

faces.unit: share of ≥2-marker team-ticks with two mark targets within 4 m
faces.what: THE dupRun-LINEAGE FACE, defensive side (radius reused verbatim: DUP_RUN_M = 4)
faces.denNote: denominator = team-ticks with ≥2 MARK-family defenders — MOVES with how often the scheme assigns two markers at all

faces.what: ≥2 bodies in the BALL family at once (the cap's own output)
≥3 bodies in the BALL family — the "NEVER three" the cap bans, as it actually occurs (the transition window licenses it)

faces.unit: share of carrier-present defending team-ticks with ≥2 bodies inside 2.6 m
faces.what: THE SWARM'S OWN FACE at the shipped stance radius — the band the cap holds today
faces.denNote: denominator = defending team-ticks with a carrier on the pitch

faces.unit: share of carrier-present defending team-ticks with ≥3 bodies inside 9 m
faces.what: the wider pile-up face at the zonal engage radius
faces.denNote: denominator = defending team-ticks with a carrier on the pitch

faces.what: how long a body waits between losing a mark and being given one
faces.denNote: denominator = completed abandon→assign cycles (a cycle broken by the team regaining possession is DISCARDED, not truncated)

faces.what: the world-9 rate at this battery's grain — a RECEIPT, never a football claim
the shipped defensive event rate at match grain
